QuestInfo.name: Feats of Dairy-do
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092000##k has something to say. He doesn't want you to pick more flowers, does he?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092000##k needs you to herd the cows. Maybe this is some sort of Pirate rookie hazing ritual?
QuestInfo.2: You took care of the cows on the ranch. Sure, they're cute, but you're ready for adventure on the high seas!
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Feed Hay to Baby Dairy Cows #i4033048:# #t4033048:# #c4033048# / 1

0.0: Hey, if you ain't too busy, mind giving me a hand? I was so busy cooking, I forgot to feed the cows. The PIRATE cows, that is\r\n
0.1: The Baby Cows get hungry real fast, too. If I don't get some food in their bellies soon, they'll probably stampede.\r\nSo, what're you waiting for? Get feeding!

yes.0: All right, the ranch is just this way. All you need to do is collect Hay by hitting Haystacks with a #rRegular Attack#k and bring the Hay to the cows. You can handle this, right?
yes.1: While you're at it, get #ba cup of Milk from the Mama Cow#k #rafter you feed the Baby Dairy Cows#k. Do a good job, and Ma will be happy to give you some milk.

no.0: Fine, be that way. It won't be my fault when you get trampled in a Baby Cow stampede.

1.0: Those cows really liked you. You ever think about changing your job to Farmer?

yes.0: Good work! Here's a glove. What do gloves have to do with cows? Who cares, you're a Pirate!

default.0: Maybe you don't think this is an important job. I want to set you straight: Don't feed those Baby Cows, and your life is on the line!
